description: Zoana wears an opaque pale-ivory floor-length noble gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Broad purple panels and rich gold woven floral/geometric borders trim the neckline, straps, sleeves, waist, center front and hem. Round worked brooches fasten the shoulder straps, and a purple-and-gold belt has an oval red-stone clasp. A deep-purple bordered wrap rests around the forearms and hangs alongside the skirt. Layered pale fabric covers the body through the pelvis and legs, with a restrained below-knee walking opening and a gold-purple closed shoe visible beneath the hem. There is no headgear, armor or weapon; all bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis remain covered by substantial opaque fabric.
